correctness.rationale: For y³=x⁴+ax²+bx+1 in characteristic 11, Cartier–Manin coefficients [x^10]f^7 and [x^21]f^7 define H=a^11 c+b^11 d. Its initial form -5a^12-2b^12 has twelve distinct tangent roots r^12=3, so the origin is an ordinary twelve-fold point. The exact finite-field elimination in source gives critical support (0,0),(±2,0),(a=-4b²,b⁴=3), with all nonorigin points on the quartic discriminant. Frobenius acts r→3/r; two fixed slopes r²=3 and five two-cycles. Independent coefficient expansion, discriminant and exhaustive 121-pair enumeration confirmed exactly 111 smooth parameter pairs and H=0 at (0,0),(4,1),(4,5),(4,6),(4,10); the source Groebner certificate, not this finite enumeration, supplies geometric elimination.
